ablation.name: d10b_dim48_gate05_15ep
ablation.notes: D10b: Capacity reduction (dim 64->48) + style gate boost (0.3->0.5). Combines D10a's content reduction with stronger style injection to compensate for potential content loss. Theory: reduced backbone has less content capacity, stronger gate forces remaining capacity toward style. Tests if style reliance can be actively boosted (not just passively increased by capacity reduction).
